verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a documented workflow to launch a cloud browser and connect via its CDP URL (browser-use-docs-2), which is the standard mechanism Playwright/Puppeteer use to attach to an existing browser, and community users independently confirm connecting local browser-use sessions to real Chrome profiles via remote debugging (browser-use-comm-3, browser-use-comm-5). However, there is no explicit documentation or example showing a Playwright or Puppeteer client library connecting directly to a Browser Use cloud session, and one community report flags the exposed CDP debugging port as an auth/security risk rather than a clean, safe path. Missing for 10: explicit first-party Playwright/Puppeteer connect() examples, safety/authentication guidance for the CDP endpoint, and independent hands-on confirmation of full compatibility with unmodified existing automation code.
